question: Find the difference in total view counts between posts authored by users who have placed a bounty of 50 on any post with 'variance' in its title and posts authored by the oldest users (by age).

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p1."XCL_030"), 0) 
     FROM posts AS p1 
     WHERE p1."XCL_033" IN (
         SELECT ph."XCL_017" 
         FROM postHistory AS ph 
         INNER JOIN posts AS p2 ON ph."XCL_014" = p2."XCL_026" 
         WHERE ph."XCL_013" = 3 
           AND ph."XCL_018" = '50' 
           AND p2."XCL_035" LIKE '%variance%'
     )) - 
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p3."XCL_030"), 0) 
     FROM posts AS p3 
     WHERE p3."XCL_033" IN (
         SELECT "XCL_052" 
         FROM users 
         WHERE "XCL_064" = (SELECT MIN("XCL_064") FROM users WHERE "XCL_064" IS NOT NULL)
     )) AS difference

    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p1."XCL_030"), 0) 
     FROM posts AS p1 
     WHERE p1."XCL_033" IN (
         SELECT ph."XCL_017" 
         FROM postHistory AS ph 
         INNER JOIN posts AS p2 ON ph."XCL_014" = p2."XCL_026" 
         WHERE ph."XCL_013" = 3 
           AND ph."XCL_018" = '50' 
           AND p2."XCL_035" LIKE '%variance%'

    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p3."XCL_030"), 0) 
     FROM posts AS p3 
     WHERE p3."XCL_033" IN (
         SELECT "XCL_052" 
         FROM users 
         WHERE "XCL_064" = (SELECT MIN("XCL_064") FROM users WHERE "XCL_064" IS NOT NULL)
     )) AS difference
